claims.subject: AHU-2 / ZN-1 — Zone Heating Design Basis
AHU-2 / ZN-1 — Zone Heating Design Basis
AHU-2 / ZN-1 — Zone Heating Design Basis
AHU-2
claims.value: heating side serving zone ZN-1 only
claims.quote: This document covers the heating side of air handling unit AHU-2 serving zone ZN-1 only.

claims.subject: Cooling, humidification and supply fan
claims.quote: Cooling, humidification and the supply fan are outside this scope and are covered by document 4471-M-12 (not issued).

claims.subject: ZN-1
claims.quote: The zone is treated as a single well-mixed thermal mass.

claims.subject: building envelope
claims.quote: Heat is lost through the building envelope to outdoor air.

claims.subject: HC-1 (preheat coil)
claims.value: injects heat into zone under thermostat control
claims.quote: A hot-water preheat coil in the AHU-2 supply duct injects heat into the zone under thermostat control.

claims.subject: envelope conductance
claims.quote: The envelope conductance is 450 W/K at design condition.

claims.subject: preheat coil
claims.quote: The preheat coil is sized at 12 kW.

claims.subject: preheat coil
claims.quote: It is an on/off coil: when the controller enables it the coil delivers its full rated duty, and when it is disabled it delivers nothing.

claims.subject: AHU-2
claims.quote: There is no face-and-bypass damper and no valve modulation in Rev A.

claims.subject: zone thermal mass
claims.quote: The zone thermal mass includes furniture and the exposed slab soffit and is taken as 300 kJ/K.
